Summary of websites shared in #general:

• www.informations.com — A job report showing mixed signals: unemployment edged down to 7.2%, bringing both relief and concern.
• www.restaurant-zurich.com — Zurich Restaurant, a cozy alpine-inspired eatery in the heart of the city, known for authentic Swiss cuisine (cheese fondue, hearty rösti, and chocolate fondue for dessert). Warm wooden interiors with Swiss memorabilia, panoramic city skyline views, and friendly staff in traditional Swiss attire make it feel like a journey to the Swiss Alps.

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website (www.dora-website.com). It's a nice, clean introduction — it clearly identifies the site as your personal website and makes it easy to get in touch via email. My feedback: it's a solid starting point, but it feels a bit sparse. Consider adding a short bio, some of your interests or work, and maybe a few links or photos so visitors get a better sense of who you are and what you do. Great foundation though — keep it up!

Hi Eve! I visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com). It's a friendly, approachable introduction — it introduces the blog as yours and shares a personal detail (your love of hiking) that gives readers an immediate sense of your personality. My feedback: it's a warm start, but there's a lot of room to grow. Adding a few actual blog posts, recent entries, and some photos from your hikes would make it much more engaging and give visitors a real reason to come back. I'd also love to read more about your hiking adventures!
